pl.title: Pracownik szklarni – automatyczny zbiór pomidorów

en.title: Greenhouse Worker – Automated Tomato Harvesting
en.summary: Harvesting tomatoes on an automated line in a greenhouse near Kozienice. No heavy lifting, comfortable temperature.

Checking and weighing crates
Keeping your workstation clean and tidy
conditions: Crates weigh up to 6 kg — everything is automated, no heavy lifting
Standing work at a comfortable temperature
Permanent, full-time job

Empleo estable a jornada completa

Trabalho fixo, tempo integral
